name: Limitless Nexus
description: Nexus build/test repository for Limitless providers. AniKoto experiments are parked in Limitless-Provider-Lab. NetMirror and Vidlink remain active validation providers; KissKH is now a standalone Nexus-owned provider with strict title ownership, domain/media fallback handling, clean labels, and no-source diagnostics.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using the shared Nexus anime identity layer with MAL/Jikan, AniList, TMDB/IMDb-backed fallbacks, specials handling, and clean quality/audio labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: WCO production provider with mirror coverage, strict title/episode ownership, anime identity support, specials handling, Power Rangers mapping, and clean quality/audio labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: AsiaFlix Test
scrapers.description: AsiaFlix v0.3.6 StreamWish canonical-player markup diagnostic based on verified-working Yuzono AniYomi AsiaFlix v32. Catalog and episode matching remain verified; the test inspects the working niramirus/medixiru player pages for scripts, iframes, forms, redirects, and player markers before reproducing the next upstream extractor step.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based directly on verified-working Yuzono AsiaFlix v32

scrapers.name: Tubi
scrapers.description: Tubi playback provider with current anonymous auth, nested episode mapping, anime identity support, Power Rangers franchise-title mapping, compact diagnostics, and quality-first labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus Tubi provider

scrapers.name: Vidlink

scrapers.name: KissKH
scrapers.description: Standalone Nexus-owned KissKH provider with strict TMDB title/alias ownership, sequential KissKH domain failover, Video/Video_tmp direct media fallback handling, EncDec video/subtitle tokens, encrypted subtitle decryption, adaptive HLS expansion when available, canonical quality/audio-subtitle labels including HSUB for Japanese hard-subbed rows, and a no-source diagnostic.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus; flow cross-checked against maintained KissKH references
